name: gizza-ai/task-format-converter
summary: Convert a task list between todo.txt, Markdown checklist, JSON, and CSV

tool.description: Convert a task list between four formats in any direction: the todo.txt plain-text spec, a GitHub-flavored Markdown checklist ('- [ ] task'), a JSON array of task objects, and CSV with a fixed header. Every format parses into a common task model — description, completion state, priority, +projects, @contexts, creation/due/completion dates, and leftover key:value tags — so those attributes survive the round trip. Set 'from' to auto to sniff the source format from the input, and 'pretty' to indent JSON output.

from.description: Source format. 'auto' sniffs it from the input (JSON braces, Markdown '- [ ]' items, a CSV header row, else todo.txt).

input.description: The task list to convert, in todo.txt, Markdown checklist, JSON, or CSV form.

pretty.description: Indent JSON output (ignored for non-JSON targets).

to.description: Target format to convert the tasks into.
